title: 10. Backfills and guideline conversion after S7
description:
Signed in as an admin who is a person, with the 5.130.2 CLI (uvx --from papyrus-newsroom==5.130.2 papyrus ...; the installed CLI is 5.126.0). (1) papyrus --site distinctive-mark.com stories head-index and references backfill-medium: dry run, then apply where they list work. (2) papyrus --site distinctive-mark.com guidelines convert (dry run, reports applied false and each lineage ready or refused), then --apply, then guidelines resolve for the publication, one section and one language, then guidelines export, then convert again: every lineage must show already_files. No one saves guidelines between S7 and convert --apply (guidelines read legacy_version in that gap). Machines on Machines: dry run 64 read requests, three lineages converted.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Guidelines are files
  Given S7 is verified
  When convert --apply has run
  Then convert shows already_files for every lineage and resolve and export work
